types.name: DateTime

types.name: TaskId
types.description: An integer identifier for a task, corresponding to the SERIAL PRIMARY KEY in the database.

types.name: Task

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique auto-incrementing identifier for the task.

fields.name: title
fields.description: The title/description of the task. Max 500 characters.

validators.error_message: Title must be between 1 and 500 characters.

fields.name: completed
fields.description: Whether the task has been completed. Defaults to false.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Timestamp when the task was created, with timezone.

types.description: A complete task object as stored in the database and returned by the API.

types.name: TaskList
types.description: An ordered list of Task objects returned by the GET /tasks endpoint.

fields.name: title

validators.error_message: Title must be between 1 and 500 characters.

fields.name: completed
fields.description: The new completion status for the task.
